issues: Document is an inspection-body (орган инспекции) accreditation scope, not a testing-lab range table: no numeric indicator/range/unit columns exist, so range_from/range_to/unit are null on every row; 'indicator' holds the вид/тип инспекции and norm_doc combines the requirement documents with the inspection/standardization method documents. No ТР ТС section headings appear anywhere in the document (only 15 lab-address group headings, per the rules these are NOT used as tr_section), so tr_section is null on every row. The scope table repeats an identical 7-object template verbatim across all 15 numbered address sections (Краснодар, Сочи, Туапсе, Ейск, Кущевская, Тихорецк, Армавир, Лабинск, Белореченск, Усть-Лабинск, Новороссийск, Анапа, etc.); this was verified page-by-page for all 57 pages, and each occurrence is transcribed as its own row set since it is a distinct row in the source table. Address/location is not part of the given schema so it is not carried in the rows. Final page is a signature page (Врио главного врача Т.П. Осмоловская) with no table rows.
